map.为什么距离翻倍降 6 dB？: Why does doubling the distance reduce by 6 dB?
map.点源声强随面积 1/r² 衰减，声级 10lg(1/r²)=−20lg r，翻倍: Point-source sound intensity attenuates with area 1/r^2; sound level 10lg(1/r^2) = -20lg r, doubling gives -6 dB.
